sections.title: About the School's Offerings

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: As many programs depend on a continuing sequence of courses completed in order, students should plan carefully to gain the maximum benefit and efficiency from their study.

sections.note:
Students are encouraged to take advantage of interdisciplinary offerings within the school.
Note that not all courses are offered every term and several are offered on a rotational basis, i.e. every third or fourth term.
An advisor is available to help plan study programs.
Students are reminded that the school is an interdisciplinary contemporary arts department, and are strongly advised to acquaint themselves with the many disciplinary courses that are available.
